items.question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses ask who knows through devotion on earth.
The preceding verse lists female figures such as the dove-woman and vulture-woman.
This verse adds further female figures to that list.
items.inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and guli-woman are likewise included among those who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identity or nature of the figures named sararī and gūlī is unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Likewise the owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sarari-woman, or the guli-woman.
